title: Implement variant assignment via deterministic hash (Stage 5)
description: Implement src/lib/ai/assign-variants.ts. This assigns a specific component variant to each section using a deterministic hash of business_name + industry. The same business always gets the same layout — consistent across regenerations.
acceptanceCriteria: Returns sections with the `variant` field set for each
Same businessName + industry always produces the same variant assignment
Only assigns valid variants (variants that exist in COMPONENT_MAP)

steps.description: Define variant options per section type
steps.details: Create `SECTION_VARIANTS: Record<SectionType, string[]>` — the list of available variant names for each section type. Example: `hero: ['centered', 'split'], services: ['grid', 'list']`, etc. This mirrors what's registered in COMPONENT_MAP.
Call `assignVariants` twice with the same input and verify the output is identical. Call with a different businessName and verify at least some variants differ.

technicalNotes: The variant assigned here is the default — users can swap it manually in the edit UI.
The hash seed includes the section type so that different sections of the same site can have different variants without correlating.
No cryptographic security needed — simple djb2 or similar hash is fine.
